chapters.about: Personal responsibility and removing harmful behaviors

summary: Mrs. Hidary explores the opening of Parashat Vaera, focusing on the transition from the name El Shaddai to Hashem and the promise of redemption. She analyzes the five expressions of redemption, explaining how they represent both divine action and the personal responsibility of B'nei Yisrael to remove the influence of Mitzrayim from themselves.
questions: Why did Hashem change the way He spoke to Moshe in this Parasha?
What is the difference between the name El Shaddai and the name Hashem?
How do the five expressions of redemption apply to our lives today?
What does it mean to take the Jew out of Egypt but also take Egypt out of the Jew?
